args.title: Fix token lifetime parsing in configuration
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

Change the token TTL parsing to support duration strings instead of misinterpreting them as integers, or validate the input to reject non-integer minutes strings. This fixes the issue of short token lifetimes caused by strings like '12h' being parsed as 12.

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/config.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The configuration code interprets the TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES environment variable strictly as an integer number of minutes, so values like '12h' are parsed as 12 instead of 720. This causes tokens to expire much sooner than expected. The fix is to validate or parse the input properly to prevent this confusion.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The health check endpoint returns HTTP 200 but reports a "degraded" status in the JSON body. The current behavior is by design: the HTTP status shows service availability, whereas the "degraded" status signals partial issues. The reporter should decide how the load balancer's probe treats this. No code change is needed.
